description: Send a message to the guest of a lead, by EMAIL or as a DIRECT_MESSAGE on the booking channel (Airbnb, VRBO or Booking.com leads only). This reaches a real guest and cannot be unsent — confirm the text first. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/messages.

lead_uid.description: The lead whose guest receives the message.
